# Svelte SPA Project

## Project Details
- **Type**: Svelte SPA (Single Page Application)
- **Framework**: SvelteKit with static adapter
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS (with Typography & Forms plugins)
- **Code Quality**: ESLint, Prettier
- **Package Manager**: npm

## Development

Start the development server:
```bash
npm run dev
```

The app runs at http://localhost:5173/

## Building

Create a production build:
```bash
npm run build
```

Preview the production build:
```bash
npm run preview
```

## VS Code Extensions

The following extensions are recommended for this project:
- Svelte for VS Code (svelte.svelte-vscode) - Already installed
- Tailwind CSS IntelliSense (bradlc.vscode-tailwindcss) - Installed

## Project Structure

This project uses SvelteKit's minimal template with:
- TypeScript for type safety
- Tailwind CSS for utility-first styling
- Static adapter for SPA deployment
- ESLint and Prettier for code quality
